data.body:
## RESOLUTION — landed via Gerrit change 2388 (MERGED), LLM-Review +1 & Verified +1

**Problem.** Since 2026-08-12, prompt-cache reads in `.rebar/usage.jsonl` dropped from ~80% of input tokens to 0%; median full plan review rose ~$2.18 → ~$4.82 (~2x). Root cause: `_intersect_capabilities` collapsed a fallback chain's `prompt_cache_style` to `"none"` whenever candidates disagreed, and commit `6d4f394195b2` (ticket `8fbd`) had configured `frontier`/`standard` as mixed Bedrock-primary + Anthropic-fallback chains — so every review call ran uncached on the Bedrock primary that serves ~99.6% of calls.

**Proven root cause (runtime).** `_intersect_capabilities([bedrock])` → `"bedrock"`; `_intersect_capabilities([bedrock, anthropic])` → `"none"` (old line: `... if len(styles) == 1 else "none"`). Timeline in `.rebar/usage.jsonl` (11,902 rows): cache-read fraction 65–82% Aug 6–11, then 0.0% from Aug 12 — matching the mixed-chain rollout. Fallback fire-rate: 51 of 11,902 calls = **0.43%**.

**(a)-is-safe determination (the decisive question).** The whole-chain collapse rested on the premise that a provider's cache keys "would error on the candidate that does not share it." Proven FALSE at runtime against the pinned pydantic-ai: the cache directive is provider-scoped `ModelSettings` keys; `ModelSettings` is a `TypedDict(total=False)` (no validation), `pydantic_ai.settings.merge_model_settings` (per served candidate in `FallbackModel`) and rebar's `build_model_settings` are unvalidated dict assemblies, and each provider model reads ONLY its own `*_cache_*` keys via `.get(...)`. A Bedrock-primary directive reaching a served Anthropic fallback is a silent `.get()` miss (uncached-but-correct), never an error, and never emits the top-level `cache_control` that Bedrock rejects (that arises only from an Anthropic-PRIMARY chain, which the config has none of). Seam not destabilised → no escalation.

**OSS grounding.** LiteLLM models caching as a per-resolved-model capability (`supports_prompt_caching(model=…)`) and "silently skips" an inapplicable directive with no error. pydantic-ai treats settings as a property of the resolved serving model (`FallbackModel` re-prepares per candidate). LangChain#37042 is the inverse anti-pattern (a shared/automatic top-level key broke Bedrock) — it argues FOR per-resolved-provider keys, AGAINST a chain-wide collapse. The fix aligns rebar with all three.

**Fix.** `_intersect_capabilities` now takes `per_candidate[0].prompt_cache_style`; hard-fail fields (`supports_temperature`, `native_structured_output`, `supports_thinking`, `native_output_with_thinking`, `native_web_search`) stay `all(...)`-intersected. Preserves ADR 0059 §2 (reads the capability FIELD, never a provider-name string; AST guard `test_capabilities_module_still_has_no_provider_name_prefix_matching` still green). Stale documented intent updated in all four sites: the `_intersect_capabilities` docstring, `rebar.toml` `[llm.model_classes]` (~190-193), `docs/llm-framework.md` (~829-840), and a superseding note in ADR 0059 §7.

**Test (RED→GREEN, mutation-checked).** New `tests/unit/test_runner_support.py` (7 tests): mixed Bedrock-primary chain keeps `"bedrock"`; Anthropic-primary keeps `"anthropic"`; `"none"`-primary stays `"none"`; homogeneous unchanged; hard-fail fields still intersect; and a parametrized fallback-fires test proving the Bedrock directive is inert on the Anthropic arm (every `anthropic_cache_*` read `None`, `UserError` unreachable). Seeding the exact historical defect turns 5/7 RED; the 2 `"none"`/homogeneous controls stay green. `make lint`, `make typecheck`, targeted suites all green; CI Verified +1 across macOS + ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13.

**Defect origin / attribution.** `caused_by = 8fbd-e9d5-326e-40d8` (`esthetical-earthborn-vervet`, commit `6d4f394195b2`), class `plan_defect`. The intersect code predates the regression (task `cc33`, `72e59d982fee`, 2026-08-02, correct-at-the-time — no mixed chains existed); `8fbd` (2026-08-10) configured the mixed chain and documented the caching loss on a false premise, so per the date test it is the origin.

**Sibling/parity sweep.** `_intersect_capabilities` has one consumer (`runner.py:515`); `capabilities.py:491` `merged_cache_style` is single-model resolution, not a chain collapse (not a sibling). Both `cache_settings_for` call sites (`runner.py:521` review path, `structured_run.py:371` structured path) consume the same intersected caps → fixed uniformly across CLI/MCP/library review paths.

**Replication (cache_read_tokens > 0).** With the primary yielding `"bedrock"`, `cache_settings_for` emits `bedrock_cache_*` breakpoints on every review call, so the Bedrock primary caches again and second-plus finder calls will log `cache_read_tokens > 0` in `.rebar/usage.jsonl` (restoring the pre-Aug-12 65–82% cache-read fraction).

**Gerrit:** change **2388** — https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2388 — LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, **MERGED**.
